## Bounded T44 preparation while T43 executes — 2026-11-02

T43 is now dispatched under #690 comment6589165585. T44 remains next in the milestone order; this is factual preparation under plan §8, not execution or a new source baseline decision.

- **P1, existing wN:p3:** derive exact `es-vendored-and-data` membership from immutable P1 selectors/inventory at2174265e9cc1b248c0fbe27fa101875984d46d6b, compare selector records with coordinator92e8d07b6163ec5ddd3e9b67f1c42a472b2911d1, and verify path/mode/blob/line/group/tier quantities against ES survey pin16dbac5211eea7e70db7394372033be2be7df829. Separate vendored code, fork-added imports, fork-modified code, catalogues/resources/build files and binary/other paths; report boundary seams with T21/T34/T35/T36. The generated594/374547/51/543/read counts are claims to reconcile, not assumptions. Return precise source/selector commands and immutable manifest hashes; no ownership recut or audit verdict.
- **T2, existing wN:p5:** reconcile the complete shared-catalogue note6375264017 with accepted T2 ES55158d2a64c69fe295fb4e67fd174424a71b1b4d and its immutable distribution handback7041b0d710363ddac7ae1b047ebae3e182548631. Map accepted later ES owner commits affecting T44 paths where named by existing issues/records (T21/T34/T35/T36), vendored-library import/version evidence and inherited findings/owners. Establish what a future T44 read must include; do not select/merge an execution pin, change catalogues, re-audit or redo the earlier ownership survey. Distinguish an immutable accepted source from a moving integration branch or M7 candidate.

Use read-only Git objects in distribution and `/home/max/Development/emulationstation-next` (confirmed local store; both named ES pins exist). Read full #691 thread, #700 and relevant complete owning issues before using their evidence. The coordinator recipe still names16dbac; its historical pin is not evidence that later accepted catalogue edits are integrated. Record discrepancies for root's brief choice.

Small private text/JSON scratch only, CPU affinity8–23. No checkout/export, source extraction, build/guest, fetch, config execution, external provider/council, physical/cloud/host-ledger action, tracker/repository/kit writes, accepted producer replay or permission answers. Historical worktrees remain untouched. Return a concise report with commands/hashes, exact unresolved factual inputs and limits to wN:p2, then stop. Root retains brief, criteria, ownership, baseline choice and dispatch.

Can this be done on the VM? These are immutable source/selector/history reads; no runtime behavior is measured or claimed.
